company_description: Mid-market to enterprise ecommerce retailer specializing in home goods and seasonal collections. Catalog ~4M SKUs, global storefronts, heavy seasonal traffic spikes (Black Friday, Cyber Week). Looking to overhaul semantic search + reranking to improve conversion and reduce manual merchandising costs.
notes:
- Overview: VelvetCart has ~4M SKUs across variants; currently using a hybrid ML + rules search stack. Interested in a RAG-style semantic layer for product discovery and a learned reranker for top results.
- Business priorities: reduce cost-per-query during peak traffic, keep 95th percentile latency for retrieval + rerank <120ms, improve top-10 relevance lift by 10-15% (measured by CTR to add-to-cart).
- POC scope: ingest ~4M embeddings (512-d) into vector store, evaluate ANN recall @ top-100, run cross-encoder reranker on top-100 -> top-10, measure end-to-end latency and cost.
- Traffic profile: baseline QPS 120, holiday spike up to 1200 QPS (10x) for ~72-hour peaks. Need autoscaling behavior + predictable pricing for spikes.
- Cost targets: business insists on average cost-per-query < $0.003 for retrieval+rerank at scale; acceptable up to $0.005 during very short peaks.
- Security/compliance: require SSO (SAML), audit logs retention 12 months, KMS integration for key management, data residency for EU storefronts.
- Technical asks from engineering: GPU-based reranker (cross-encoder) affinity to dedicated capacity, ability to fallback to quantized cheaper reranker model during overload, streaming responses for typeahead.
- Quote: CTO (Ana Rodrigues) on 2026-02-12 call: "We can't undercut margins on peak events; need a clear unit economics model that doesn't surprise finance."
